# Put your ideas on a page.

Welcome to **Meki**, a quiet Markdown writing space.
Start here. Your words, structure, and equations take shape as you type.

## Write without switching back and forth

Type `# ` to start a heading, use **bold** for emphasis, and *italics* for a quieter voice.
Select text to format it, or type `/` on an empty line to insert content.

> Let the tools step back and the words come forward.

## Make equations part of your writing

From simple inline math like $E = mc^2$ to an equation on its own line:

$$
\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-x^2}\,dx = \sqrt{\pi}
$$

Click an equation to edit its LaTeX, or use **∑** in the toolbar to insert one.

## Organize ideas with diagrams

Choose “Insert Mermaid diagram” in the toolbar, or write a `mermaid` code fence. Click a diagram to edit its source. Preview, HTML, and PDF all support offline diagrams.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[Idea] --> B[Write] --> C[Share]
```

## Your files stay local

- [x] Live Markdown editing and source mode
- [x] Inline math, display equations, and code blocks
- [x] Native file access and unsaved draft recovery
